title: Update to SendGrid Domain Authentication: Send to Coworker Action Removed
impact_summary: The Send to Coworker action has been removed from the Domain Authentication setup flow, eliminating a low‑usage feature.

title: Verify tightens fraud prevention geo permissions for Italy and Argentina

backbase_rationale: Ensures compliance with enhanced fraud protection policies in targeted countries.
